faq.q: Do I need to be an engineering major?
faq.a: No — SHPE welcomes all STEM majors. The career fair recruits across engineering, computing, and the sciences.
The chapter subsidizes registration, group travel, and lodging for registered delegates. Exact subsidy depends on funding each year. TODO-confirm.

faq.q: I've never been to a convention. Is it for me?
faq.a: Especially for you. We run a prep bootcamp beforehand and travel as a group — first-timers are the reason the prep track exists.

faq.q: When do I need to commit?
faq.a: Watch the key-dates timeline above and the chapter mailing list. Early registration saves the most money.
